newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 19.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Madam Chiang Kai-shek agrees to let bodies of late President Chiang Kai-shek and Chiang Ching-kuo remain in Taiwan.
President Lee Teng-hui urges consensus on constitutional reforms.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Peru rebels hold hundreds of hostages at Japanese ambassador's home in Lima.
Taiwan to study reforms on government system.
LIBERTY TIMES - Peru rebels attacks Japanese ambassador's home, holding hundreds of hostages.
Some 60 percent of National Development Conference participants support abolition of Taiwan provincial government.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Chinese Petroleum Corp to release shares next year (1997).
Taiwan to adjust M2 money supply target zone to 8-13 percent.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Bidding prices for state land higher than expected.
Taiwan, mainland China, Hong Kong business leaders consider setting up joint-venture bank in Hong Kong.
